import ctypes

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the strtol function prototype
strtol = gsl.strtol
strtol.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_char_p), ctypes.c_int]
strtol.restype = ctypes.c_long

# Python function to convert string to unsigned integer
def str_to_unsigned_int(s):
    end_ptr = ctypes.c_char_p()
    result = strtol(s.encode('utf-8'), ctypes.byref(end_ptr), 10)
    if result < 0:
        raise ValueError("Negative number cannot be converted to unsigned integer")
    return result

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    assert str_to_unsigned_int('123') == 123, "Test case 1 failed"
    assert str_to_unsigned_int('0') == 0, "Test case 2 failed"
    assert str_to_unsigned_int('4294967295') == 4294967295, "Test case 3 failed"
    try:
        str_to_unsigned_int('-1')
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        assert False, "Test case 4 failed: Negative number should raise ValueError"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
